name: roi_xz3_postselect60_inherit_xonly_tuning_row_pilot_b500
description: ROI paired VCTR exploratory pilot with the three nominally significant VF covariates from the prior 60Z analysis and paired-row bootstrap.
model_label: X+Z3 post-selection paired VCTR row-bootstrap pilot
notes: Post-selection exploratory pilot only; not valid as selection-adjusted manuscript inference.
The three VF columns were selected because their nominal 95% patient-bootstrap CIs excluded zero in the prior unpenalized ROI 60Z model.
Paired-visit rows are sampled with replacement; OD and OS remain paired within each sampled row.
Repeated visits from the same patient are treated as independent by this row-bootstrap sensitivity design.
S, R, h, and hbar are inherited from the prediction-selected ROI X-only model and are not X+Z3-optimal tuning.
CP features and all preprocessing transformations remain fixed.
